short: British intelligence intercepted a secret German proposal for a military alliance with Mexico against the United States.
full:
On 16 January 1917, the German Foreign Office sent a coded telegram to their ambassador in Mexico, proposing an alliance if the United States entered the war against Germany. In exchange, Germany promised to help Mexico recover territories lost to the US in the 1840s, including Texas, New Mexico, and Arizona.

British naval intelligence intercepted and deciphered the message, handing it over to the American government in late February. Its publication outraged the American public, who were already incensed by Germany's resumption of unrestricted submarine warfare. The telegram eroded the last pillars of American neutrality and was instrumental in bringing the United States into the First World War just weeks later.
